Criteria.Skill: Source 5.1 selects every correct directed translation card and rejects reverse/different vectors with arithmetic
Source 5.2 labels all four x/y axis reflection images with correct sign and preserved coordinate including large magnitudes
Source 5.3 uses exact specified rotation centers for all segment endpoints and explains preserved length
First-party Cool-down distinguishes 90° CCW about O from y-axis reflection using all corresponding points and orientation

correct: Select cards 1 and 3 with exact (+4,+2), reject 2 and 4
Segment CCW90 A around B -> (3,-1), B around A -> (1,3)
Cool-down Image I rotation 90° CCW; II reflection in x=0
equivalent: Written vectors (+4,+2) and verbal four-right/two-up are equal
Equivalent signed integer/decimal point representations and labelled sketches
Same transformation geometry justified by rigid lengths/angle properties
wrong: Reflect x-axis by negating x instead of y
Rotate around origin when center is B for endpoint A
Call Image I a reflection or Image II a counterclockwise rotation
malformed: Only final letters without vector calculation or reasons
Unlabelled point images and missing axis designation
Missing B/center when constructing segment rotation
No corresponding point mapping for Cool-down
boundary: Large 570 magnitude still reflects to -570, not to 0
On a mirror axis x=0 or y=0 a point remains fixed
90° CCW about nonorigin center uses X-C rotated then +C, not direct origin formula
Distinct alternative explanations with exact same transformation should be teacher accepted
Exact coordinate pair (3,-1) not numerically equivalent to (3,-1.0000001)
